code_examples.section: ltm rule event MQTT SERVER EGRESS
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

MQTT_SERVER_EGRESS
       An iRule event that triggers when an MQTT message is sent to server-side.

DESCRIPTION
       This iRule event triggers when an MQTT message is sent to server-side.  In case an MQTT message has large payload such as
       for server PUBLISH message types, this event may trigger before entire payload is sent. In that case, MQTT::collect may be
       used to obtain the payload.

       NOTE: This event is implemented only for Message Routing based MQTT Sessions

Examples
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-14.0.0
	   --First introduced the event.
